text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a branch of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, get movie recommendations, or unlock our phones with our faces. AI also helps doctors, banks, and companies make faster and smarter decisions.
